pla-matte.desc: Matte PLA without gloss - prints have a uniform matte texture that hides layers well. Easy to print and fully biodegradable. Ideal for figurines, decorations and parts that should look good.

pla-silk.desc: PLA with a silky, almost chrome-like shine and a smooth, mirror-like surface. It has better layer adhesion than regular silk and prints easily, but is still more decorative than functional - the shine hides minor defects, while strength remains low.
traits: Outer wall at 50 mm/s for shine

pla-basic.desc: Classic, versatile PLA with a smooth surface. The easiest material to print and fully biodegradable - good for prototypes, models and most everyday prints that are not heavily loaded.

petg-hf.desc: PETG High Flow - a strong, slightly flexible material resistant to impacts, moisture and outdoor conditions, with a smooth, soft-touch surface. High Flow enables fast printing with little tuning. Great for functional parts, enclosures and parts under load.

petg-translucent.desc: Translucent PETG with a slightly see-through, milky appearance. Strong, easy to print and not prone to warping. Great for lampshades, decorative parts and enclosures that need to let some light through.

0.summary: The simplest and most forgiving printing material - it tolerates mistakes and looks good even without finely tuned settings, though it can smell a little during printing. It is rigid but fairly brittle and softens at elevated temperatures, so it is unsuitable for parts exposed to heat or heavy loads.
0.good: Figurines, decorations, prototypes and similar prints. Models that simply need to look good
0.avoid: Sunny locations, frost and heavy mechanical loads

1.summary: Combines relatively easy printing with real strength - resistant to impacts, moisture and higher temperatures, and tends to bend under pressure rather than break immediately. The HF (High Flow) variant enables faster printing and is a material you can rely on for functional parts.
1.good: Enclosures, handles, mounts and functional or mechanical parts
1.avoid: Very small, precise details intended purely for decoration
